findings.change: When this goal is handed in or landed, add the consequences paragraph to the landing or squash commit message. No file in the repository needs to change.
findings.claim: The brief asks for the consequences to be written in the commit message body, but the unit commit's message has none. The missing consequences are: the inactivity limit doubles; the overall time ceiling (eight times the limit) rises from two to four hours per command; runs that are already frozen keep the old value; and the change is undone by setting 30 back to 15 once kept shard timings justify it.
findings.evidence: 'git show 28c891a976' prints only the subject 'goal unit-check-deadline-matches-current-runtime units U1' and the Goal-Unit and Goal-Whole trailers. The unit runner wrote this commit message, not the builder, which was told to leave its change uncommitted. The same consequences are already recorded in the goal's Next step on its goal page. No code, test or proof is affected.
